speaker: Doctor
text: Thank you for seeing me. I see you have chronic left shoulder pain without a history of trauma. To better understand your condition, how would you describe the exact location and nature of the pain?

speaker: Patient
text: 55-year-old woman. The patient reports a 2-month history of insidious onset left shoulder pain, worsening with extreme ranges of motion and activity. Pain disrupts sleep, and there's noted difficulty with activities of daily living like brushing hair and dressing. No history of shoulder trauma, neck pain, arm/hand weakness, numbness, or paresthesias. The patient has type 2 diabetes mellitus, treated with metformin and glipizide.

speaker: Doctor
text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Adhesive Capsulitis (Frozen Shoulder) in a diabetic patient. Given the age, diabetes history, insidious onset, and specific limitation in active range of motion affecting daily activities, I am confident in this clinical diagnosis. No further tests are required at this time.
